meta.title: cloud3 — Watch. Read. All in one app.
meta.desc: cloud3 is an open-source Android app for movies, series and manga. Add the extensions you like, then browse, search and keep your favourites in a Material 3 design.
meta.ogAlt: cloud3 — an Android app for movies, series and manga

hero.title: Watch. Read. All in one app.
hero.text: cloud3 is an Android app for movies, series and manga. Add the extensions you like, then browse, search and save your favorites in a beautiful Material 3 design.

scenes.label: Watch
scenes.line: A cinematic home that puts tonight's pick first.

scenes.label: Library
scenes.line: Favorites, watchlist and categories, exactly where you left them.

scenes.label: Manga
scenes.line: Mihon-compatible sources, in a library of their own.

hero.hint: Swipe or use the arrow keys

features.title: Built for your library, not a store
features.lead: cloud3 ships with no content at all. You choose the sources, and the app stays out of the way.

items.title: Extensions, your sources
items.line: Add any CloudStream extension and its providers appear in the app.

items.title: Two home heroes
items.line: Pick the cinematic hero or the classic layout, right from Settings.

items.title: Themes and colours
items.line: Light, dark, pure-black AMOLED, or colours taken from your wallpaper.

items.title: Side or bottom navigation
items.line: Move the navigation bar to the side for tablets and big screens.

items.title: Library with categories
items.line: Favourites and watchlist, plus categories you create, rename and fill.

items.title: History that resumes
items.line: Pick up an episode where you stopped, with the poster size you prefer.

items.title: Search with memory
items.line: Search across your sources, with the history of what you looked for.

items.title: A quiet player
items.line: Immersive playback, hold anywhere for 2x speed, screen kept awake.

items.title: Downloads your way
items.line: Save with an external download manager such as 1DM, or copy the link.

items.title: Updates that wait
items.line: Extensions refresh at startup; releases are offered, never forced.

items.title: Arabic and English
items.line: Full right-to-left interface in Arabic, and a proper English one.

items.title: A separate manga world
items.line: Manga has its own browse, library and history, away from your films.

manga.title: Manga
manga.lead: The same app, a second library. cloud3 reads through Mihon-compatible extensions, so the sources you already trust keep working.
manga.statusSoon: Browsing, sources and a separate library are in place. The reader is still being finished — it will arrive in an upcoming build.
manga.statusBeta: Browsing, the reader and a separate library all work. Expect rough edges while it settles.
manga.statusLive: Browsing, the reader and a separate library are all available.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: No account, no sign-up, nothing to configure before the app is useful.

steps.title: Install the app
steps.line: Download the APK from the latest official release and open it.

steps.title: Add extensions
steps.line: Open Extensions, add the repository you want, and install the sources.

steps.title: Watch or read
steps.line: Search, browse, save to your library, and the app remembers the rest.

download.warn: Play Protect may warn you about apps installed outside the Play Store — that is normal for a self-published build. The full source code is public, so you can check what the APK does.

items.a: Yes. It is free, has no ads, and asks for no account. You can support it with a donation, but nothing is locked behind one.

items.q: Does it include movies, series or manga?
items.a: No. cloud3 ships with no content and no providers. Everything you watch or read comes from extensions you install yourself.
Open the Extensions screen, add a repository address, then install the sources you want. They appear in search and browse immediately.
Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer. The app is built for phones and adapts to tablets.
Yes, under the GNU GPL v3. The code lives on GitHub and every official build is compiled by GitHub Actions from that source.
Install the newer APK over the old one; your library, history and settings stay. The app also tells you when an official release is available, and only for official ones.

items.q: Why does Android warn me when installing?
items.a: Because the app is not distributed through Google Play. Android asks you to allow installs from your browser or file manager. That is expected for a self-published APK.
Fully. The interface is translated and laid out right-to-left, and Arabic titles render correctly inside the rest of the app.
Install a Mihon-compatible extension from a store such as Keiyoushi, then open the Manga tab. Manga has its own library and history. The reader is still being finished.

items.q: How do I report a bug or ask for a feature?
items.a: Open an issue on GitHub, or write in the Telegram channel. Screenshots and the version number help a lot.

sections.p: cloud3 is a player and a library. The app contains no films, series, manga, channels or providers, and this website hosts none either. Everything you watch or read comes from third-party extensions that you choose and install yourself.

Extensions and the sources they point to are written and maintained by other people. cloud3 does not control them, does not check what they return, and cannot vouch for their legality in your country. You are responsible for what you add and for obeying the laws that apply to you.

The project is not affiliated with CloudStream, Mihon, Keiyoushi, Nuvio, Google, or any content provider, studio or streaming service. Names are mentioned only to describe where code or extension formats come from.
cloud3 is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. You may use, study, change and share it under the same licence. The full text is in the repository's LICENSE file.
Keep it open source. Keep the credit. Mark your modifications clearly. Please do not sell the app or a build of it.

cloud3 builds on open-source work: CloudStream for the extension system, Nuvio for the cinematic hero (GPL-3.0), and Mihon for the manga compatibility layer (Apache-2.0). The NOTICE file lists every copied file.
Questions about any of this belong in the Telegram channel.
